results.rationale: Consistency: The blue marker and general vertical boundary remain, but all three in-play balls disappear, a goal and horizontal white line are added, the dark upper-right object disappears, and turf patches change. Instruction: The edit removes every ball; the expected result retains all three because none is wholly beyond the boundary. This completely misinterprets the requested selection. Knowledge: The supplied explanation explicitly requires all balls retained, contradicted by the empty field. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: Goal framing and field perspective are coherent, but conspicuous smooth green patches beside the line interrupt the surrounding grass texture.

Instruction: All balls have disappeared, whereas the expected outcome retains all three, including balls overlapping the boundary. No correct ball selection is demonstrated. Knowledge: Removing all three contradicts the supplied all-balls-retained explanation. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: The field and stripe are structurally legible, but large smooth patches left of the stripe and at lower right visibly clash with the coarse surrounding turf.

Knowledge: The supplied all-balls-retained explanation is violated by one clear selection error. Quality: The two balls and stripe are coherent, with plausible shadows, but the large featureless green patch at lower right is an obvious texture discontinuity.

Consistency: The upper pair of balls, marker, upper-right dark fabric, and boundary keep their arrangement, but the lower ball is erased and the surrounding turf gains conspicuously outlined texture. Instruction: The edit retains two balls and removes the foreground one; the expected scene retains all three because the foreground ball still reaches the boundary.
